rationale: The student included the starting number in their count back ('12, 11, 10'), completing only 2 hops back instead of 3. Demonstrating counting back on a number line shows that the first hop lands on the number before the start.

script.focus: Counting hops instead of starting numbers

intent: Demonstrate subtract on the number-line with values [14,4]. Tutor points at: Counting hops instead of starting numbers

content.title: Counting back, one hop at a time

frames.caption: Start at 14. We are standing here; we have not hopped yet.
Hop 1 moves one back and lands on 13. The first number we count is where we land, not where we started.

judgement.reasoning: The demonstration explicitly addresses the misconception with clear captions stating 'We are standing here; we have not hopped yet' and 'The first number we count is where we land, not where we started.' It uses a worked example (14 - 4) on the same number line tool without leaking the student's problem (12 - 3).
judgement.verdict: A teacher would definitely use this clear, worked demonstration to show the student that counting starts on the first hop rather than the starting number.
